issue.body:
What is your opinion about having a service locator API in the framework?
With this, we can use contracts to inject dependencies as well as easily share and replace components.
Also this would be a very nice feature for extension writers as they would be able to independently expose services.

http://code.activestate.com/recipes/413268/
https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/tutorial/dependencies/first-steps/

We also can use type hints for automatic service resolution.
https://laravel.com/docs/5.7/container
https://symfony.com/doc/current/service_container.html
issue.title: APIs for service locator/IoC?
